accounting_gaps: CPU for the interrupted in-flight case and some earlier exploratory/test invocations was not retained; known_recorded_cpu_s is a conservative lower bound, not an exact whole-session total.
GNU time reports the final clean-command CPU aggregate to 0.01 second precision; retained campaign counters preserve their original finer precision.
Web-tool-managed literature and rules-page transfer bytes were not metered. No byte-exact total-download claim is made.
Interactive inspection, literature reading, packaging, and some compilation outside the recorded final clean command set are not included.
The final post-seal archive validation is reported in the sibling artifact audit rather than written back into the archive it checked.
retained_input_policy: Exact original JSON inputs; cited papers are not redistributed; no external experimental dataset.
scope: Recorded scientific runs plus clean candidate/final-package reproduction commands; not all conversation, browsing, or interactive inspection activity.
